name: GuestRequestServiceDesk
tagline: Every guest request and complaint routed, timed and followed up – with service recovery the duty manager can trust.
description: A complete hotel guest service desk for Power Apps and Power Pages: log requests and complaints by room, route them to the right department automatically, let the rules set the priority (complaints, urgent categories, VIP guests, repeat issues), track response and resolution SLAs live, escalate to the department supervisor and the duty manager, dispatch work per department, record service recovery within each role's authority, follow up complaints with a satisfaction score and see which in-house guests are at risk – in one Power Apps code component with demo data, Power Fx outputs and events.
features: Automatic department routing from the category
Priority rules: complaint, urgent categories, VIP levels, repeat issues per stay
Response and resolution SLA by priority with live timers
Escalation to the department supervisor (100%) and duty manager (configurable %)
Required fields per status (assignee, hold reason, resolution, recovery for complaints)
Service recovery with agent / supervisor / duty-manager authority limits
Suggested recovery by priority and VIP
Follow-up call with satisfaction 1–5 before a complaint is closed
Guest risk score and in-house guest view
Duplicate-ticket check per room and category
Demo mode with a fictional hotel
Phone card list and bottom view switcher
